transcript.content: Hi, it’s good to meet you. What brings you in today?

...It's work. Down at the warehouse. 

I'm just... well, I'm having some trouble with the routing system there. It's not just a normal computer to me anymore. I've noticed—actually, I know—that it's been marking my moves. It sends these messages through the scanners. They're trying to push me out, just because I'm one of the old hands. 

So... that's why I'm here.
Have you heard voices or other sounds that other people couldn't hear?

...Yeah. I suppose. 

It's... well, even when I'm off the clock. Sitting out in my garage, with everything completely shut off. I... I still hear the dispatch voices. Clear as day. 

They'll call out my operator number. And they... they say I'm dangerous. Or that security is coming for me. I don't know if anyone else can hear it... but I do.
Have you been feeling depressed most of the day nearly every day?

...Yeah. I guess so. 

It's been... well, for most of this whole trouble, really. Even when the warehouse stuff... when the fears about the routing system were a little quieter for a bit, I was still just... down. Empty, I suppose. 

I haven't been able to get myself back into... well, anything. Not fishing. Not woodworking out in the garage. I don't even really join in on family meals anymore. Just... haven't had it in me.
Have the voices or the feeling that the routing system is targeting you ever continued during a time when you were not feeling depressed?

...Yeah. I suppose so. 

There was... a bit of time a while back. I wasn't feeling quite as low. I was... eating a little more, sitting with my wife for a bit. But... 

I still heard them. For a few weeks there, even when I felt okay... dispatch was still calling my number. And I knew the system was still tracking me. It didn't stop.
About how long have you been hearing the dispatch voices?

...A while. 

I haven't kept a calendar or anything. But... maybe a year and eight months? Give or take. That's... that's how long the dispatch voices have been there. Same with the... the scanner stuff. About a year and eight months.
Have you ever had a period where you felt unusually high, energized, or euphoric for days at a time?

...No. I don't think so. 

I don't really get... energized like that. Just the opposite, mostly.
During this whole period of trouble, have you been depressed for most of the time?

...Yeah. I suppose so. 

Most of the time, really. Even when the... the warehouse stuff wasn't as loud for a bit, I was still just... down. Empty. 

Couldn't really get myself to do much. Didn't care about fishing... or my woodworking. Couldn't even sit through family meals. Just... heavy. For most of it.
